dedupe_keys.name: an unmanned aerial vehicle captured dataset for railroad segmentation and obstacle detection

description: An unmanned aerial vehicle captured dataset for railroad segmentation and obstacle detection is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Rampriya R. S. et al. Railways transport millions of passengers and employees daily, and safety measures aim to prevent injuries and fatalities. In order to guarantee passenger safety, computer vision, unmanned aerial vehicles (UAV), and artificial intelligence will be essential tools in the near future for routinely evaluating the railway environment. Coverage: not stated; published in 2024. Formats: Image, ZIP. The data are held in Zenodo and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
